Find the component that draws the list, and look at what it shows for each ingredient when the servings are not the recipe's.

`client/src/components/IngredientList.tsx` computes `scaled` and then, when the servings changed, builds `shown` by looking up each ingredient of the recipe in `scaled` with `find`. `find` returns the first item for which the function returns something truthy. Read that function character by character.

The lookup is `scaled.find((item) => (item.id = ingredient.id))`: one `=`, an assignment. It writes the id into the first item and returns that id, which is truthy, so `find` always stops at the first item. Comparing with `===` fixes the lookup, but the lookup is not needed at all: `scaleIngredients` already returns the ingredients in order, each with its scaled quantity, for any servings. Render `scaled.map(...)` and delete `shown`.
